types.name: GlobalConfigParams
docs: Mutable protocol parameters.

fields.name: midao_llc_id
docs: Legal entity registry ID (MIDAO DAO LLC / Verein).

fields.name: legal_contract_hash
docs: SHA-256 of the signed Operating Agreement.

fields.name: founder_shares
docs: Founder allocation (share atoms), vested linearly after the cliff.

fields.name: round_terms
docs: Terms of funding round 0 (flat curve).

fields.name: trading_fee_bps
docs: Optional trading fee in basis points (100 to 500 bps, default 200 bps).

types.name: RoundTerms
docs: Economic terms of a flat-curve funding round.

fields.name: price_per_share_usdc
docs: USDC atoms per whole share (e.g. `100_000` = 0.10 USDC). Constant for the round.

fields.name: target_cap_usdc
docs: Hard cap in USDC atoms. The round only closes when exactly this amount is raised.

fields.name: upfront_working_capital_bps
docs: Upfront runway paid to the founder treasury at graduation (max 1,500 bps).

fields.name: trading_fee_bps
docs: Optional trading fee in basis points (100 to 500 bps, default 200 bps).

types.name: GlobalConfig
docs: Protocol-wide configuration. `[b"global_config"]`

fields.name: admin
docs: Protocol admin (must be the program upgrade authority at initialization).

fields.name: fee_treasury
docs: Owner of the USDC account that receives the protocol royalty on DLMM fees.

fields.name: legal_setup_authority
docs: Authority allowed to release escrowed legal setup fees (e.g. MIDAO payment).

fields.name: usdc_mint
docs: Quote mint used by every venture (canonical USDC on mainnet).

fields.name: vent_mint
docs: $VENT mother token mint (governance).

fields.name: vent_stake_vault
docs: Program-owned vault holding all staked $VENT. `[b"vent_stake_vault"]`

fields.name: dlmm_preset_parameter
docs: Meteora DLMM `PresetParameter2` used to create every venture pool.

fields.name: total_vent_staked
docs: Sum of all staked $VENT (quorum denominator).

fields.name: min_approval_bps
docs: Approval requires `for_bps > min_approval_bps` (>= 5000 => strict majority).

fields.name: verification_quorum_bps
docs: Minimum participation (for + against) relative to `total_vent_staked`, in bps.

fields.name: protocol_fee_bps
docs: Royalty on harvested DLMM USDC fees routed to `fee_treasury` (e.g. 50 = 0.5%).

types.name: VentStakePosition
docs: A staker's position in the $VENT governance pool. `[b"vent_stake", staker]`
Voting locks the position until the end of the ballot, so the same tokens can
never be moved to another wallet and counted twice.

fields.name: locked_until
docs: Unix timestamp until which `unstake_vent` is blocked (max over all ballots voted on).

types.name: DlmmCustody
docs: Permanent custodian of the venture's Meteora DLMM liquidity. `[b"dlmm_custody", venture]`
This PDA is the `owner` of every DLMM position funded by the venture and the
authority of the custody token accounts. The program exposes **no** instruction
that removes liquidity or closes a position, so the LP is permanently locked;
only accrued trading fees can be harvested (`harvest_dlmm_fees`).

fields.name: custody_usdc
docs: `[b"custody_usdc", venture]`

fields.name: custody_shares
docs: `[b"custody_shares", venture]`

types.name: MilestoneEscrow
docs: Tranche-specific milestone escrow. `[b"milestone_escrow", funding_round]`

fields.name: escrow_usdc_vault
docs: `MilestoneEscrowUsdcVault`. `[b"milestone_usdc_vault", milestone_escrow]`

fields.name: primary_tokens_quorum_base
docs: Round shares sold (quorum base for milestone votes).

fields.name: primary_tokens_remaining
docs: Decrements on ragequit.

types.name: MilestoneInput
docs: Founder roadmap input, committed before the curve opens so $VENT stakers vote on it.

fields.name: amount_usdc
docs: Nominal allocation fixed at graduation (scaled by remaining/base on release).

types.name: FundingRound
docs: Terms, treasury custody and lifecycle of funding round N.
`[b"funding_round", venture, &[round_index]]`

fields.name: receipt_mint
docs: $VENT-RN receipt mint (mint & freeze authority = this PDA; receipts are non-transferable).

fields.name: usdc_vault
docs: `funding_round_usdc_vault`: escrow holding all primary USDC until graduation/refund.

fields.name: dlmm_position
docs: Meteora DLMM position funded by this round (owned by `DlmmCustody`).

fields.name: price_per_share_usdc
docs: Flat price: USDC atoms per whole share (e.g. 100_000 = 0.10 USDC).

fields.name: shares_for_sale
docs: `target_cap_usdc * ONE_SHARE / price_per_share_usdc` (exact).

fields.name: receipts_outstanding
docs: Outstanding receipts (net of sellbacks and refunds).

fields.name: dlmm_active_id
docs: Expected DLMM active bin (flat price) recorded by `prepare_dlmm_pool`.

types.name: RoundInvestorRecord
docs: Primary backer ledger for one round. `[b"round_record", funding_round, investor]`

fields.name: usdc_contributed
docs: Net USDC contributed (sellbacks decrement).

fields.name: tokens_purchased
docs: Net receipts purchased (sellbacks decrement).

fields.name: tokens_surrendered
docs: Shares surrendered through milestone ragequit.

fields.name: vote_mask
docs: Bit i = voted YES on milestone i in its current review cycle.

fields.name: veto_mask
docs: Bit i = voted VETO on milestone i in its current review cycle.

fields.name: amendment_seen
docs: Review cycle (amendment count) the masks refer to, per milestone.

types.name: StakerVotingRecord
docs: One staker's ballot. `[b"staker_vote", verification_vote, staker]`

types.name: VentureVerificationVote
docs: On-chain $VENT staker approval ballot for one round.
`[b"verification_vote", funding_round]`

fields.name: total_vent_staked_snapshot
docs: `GlobalConfig::total_vent_staked` captured at `CapReached` (quorum denominator).

fields.name: voting_start_timestamp
docs: Set exactly when the round reaches `CapReached` (0 before).

fields.name: voting_end_timestamp
docs: `voting_start_timestamp + 14 days` (0 before `CapReached`).

types.name: InvestorVault
docs: Personal staking vault and dividend ledger. `[b"investor_vault", venture, investor]`

fields.name: effective_weight
docs: `staked_amount * multiplier_bps`.

fields.name: last_acc_yield
docs: O(1) accumulator checkpoint.

fields.name: pending_usdc
docs: Settled but unclaimed USDC.

types.name: FounderVesting
docs: Founder vesting schedule. `[b"founder_vesting", venture, founder]`

types.name: VentureState
docs: Master company state machine. `[b"venture", venture_token_mint]`

fields.name: treasury_wallet
docs: Wallet that owns the OpCo treasury USDC account (upfront runway + milestone payouts).

fields.name: midao_llc_id
docs: Legal entity registry ID (MIDAO DAO LLC / Verein).

fields.name: legal_contract_hash
docs: SHA-256 of the signed Operating Agreement.

fields.name: circulating_public_float
docs: Shares that left the master vault into the market (redemptions + DLMM seed).

fields.name: unredeemed_receipt_shares
docs: Shares owed to receipt holders of graduated rounds (reserved in the master vault).

fields.name: acc_dividend_per_weight_unit
docs: O(1) dividend accumulator (scaled by ACC_PRECISION * 10_000).

fields.name: is_round_active
docs: Sequential round mutex.
